reviews: The set up and app are very easy to use and most of the time I can get clips when ever there is movement - even if she is just turning over or adjusting her blanket on the couch. However, I find there are sometimes big chunks of time when I know there's activity but no saved clip from the camera. For example: I have set up 2 blink mini's in my elderly mother's apartment and I will see a clip of her leaving the bedroom to go into the living room and then the next clip is an hour later when she is coming in from the hall way. No clip of her leaving the living room. This happens often. Since I have installed the camera to identify falls, this is a bit of a concern especially if she were to fall during that hour of no recording because there would be no movement while she's lying on the floor for the cameral to catch. Sometimes I will see someone leaving but there is no saved clip for when they came in.

I am overall pleased with the Blink cameras for my needs. The app however has some frustrating issues. The two biggest are: 1. When viewing clip history, you cannot filter to show only clips which have not been viewed. If you have a busy few days and can't watch each clip, good luck marking them all as viewed. 2. Live view audio plays through phone speaker and uses the call volume. It can't be silenced nor will it play through headphones. Recordings play as expected. Please fix!

children.label: monitoring
children.name: monitoring
reviews: This app was atrocious when I first got the system in 2016, and it's still atrocious in all the same ways despite all the reskins and "firmware updates" on the device. Unfortunately, they have little incentive to make the app actually work well, since it's very unlikely to sell more cameras. I ditched Arlo for quite a few years (despite having sunk a lot of money in the hardware) and was using a free(ish) app, TrackView, which did every single thing better and smoother than Arlo. Unfortnutely, TrackView just stopped working outright, and I had to dig up my old Arlo cameras... until I figured out how to set up TrackView again (you have to sideload it because Google any app that wants video and audio access that's sufficient for monitoring must be malicious... genius). In Arlo, every single step of trying to use the camera is painfully slow: The app takes several seconds to load, THEN several seconds to "hydrate" and load additional menus like "mode" (EVEN IF IT'S IN THE MODE TAB ALREADY?!?!), several seconds to connect to "live" mode, there's a consistent 5-10 second delay in "live" mode from what's actually happening. The two-way communication takes several ADDITIONAL seconds to "connect"?!?! and then the two-way communication is also extremely delayed. At some point it just stopped being able to connect to the camera, EXCEPT if I went into settings to pretend like I was adjusting the recording area, and in that interface it showed me the live feed perfectly well?!?! It would still alert me, but didn't record anything either. How is this possible? I ended up having to reset and reinstall everything. I use the camera to watch my dog(s) when I'm out of the house, or try to. Today I was walking the dogs one at a time, and it just randomly logged me out in between the two dogs, so when I went out with the second one, I discovered that I didn't have eyes on the dog at home. Then when I came back it just randomly logged me back in without my input. It didn't record anything while it was logged out, even though my dog clearly should have triggered it - lots of stuff was moved around while I was gone. It started triggering on my voice as soon as it decided to log me back in. How is triggering and recording video even tied to the app?!?!?Geofencing is a joke, its idea of where you are is only very loosely tied to reality. And it's really hard to even tell where the hell it thinks you are, and whether it thinks you're at home or not. You have to infer it from clues in other parts of the app. I don't even have the energy to complain about the horrible interface choices, those I could at least live with if the functionality worked as promised.
